description.en: Log errors with context, search past ones, and record resolutions so you stop re-debugging the same failure.

Normalises OpenAI-compatible SSE streams so a content or reasoning delta that arrives after the finish reason cannot kill a session ("OpenAI Chat received content after the finish reason"). A stream the gateway cuts mid-generation is left unterminated — n

Set an objective for a session and keep working until it is reached: the goal is re-injected into every request, the model auto-continues when a turn ends, and the loop stops only on goal_complete/goal_blocked, a user interrupt, a stall, or the iteration/
